title: feat(app-shell): render a record on a named record page at /apps/APP/OBJECT/record/ID/page/PAGE
body:
Fixes #12715
Clause-②: yes

## What

A console URL that renders a record on a NAMED record page, so the server's print service can print any record page of an object, not only its default one.

**URL shape (the contract objectstack's print service binds to):**

    /apps/APP/OBJECT/record/ID/page/PAGE

Route `:objectName/record/:recordId/page/:pageName`, declared beside the record route in `packages/app-shell/src/console/AppContent.tsx` as `RECORD_NAMED_PAGE_ROUTE`. The record route `/apps/APP/OBJECT/record/ID` is unchanged, and it still opens the object's default record page.

## Behaviour

- PAGE renders for record ID only when it is a record page bound to OBJECT (`type: 'record'`, `object: OBJECT`). A page that declares `print` renders with its print stylesheet and its print root (`data-print-page`), and `window.__objectui.idle` behaves as on the record route. Those are the two signals the print driver's ready predicate reads.
- Any other name shows the console's existing "Page Not Found" state. That covers an unknown name, a page that is not a record page, and another object's record page. There is never a fallback to the default page and never another page. No record is read and no print root is stamped, so a print of a wrong URL cannot put a wrong document on paper.
- While the page list loads, only the skeleton is drawn, never the default page.
- An embedded detail (drawer or split pane) never reads the segment.

## How

- `RecordDetailView` reads `pageName` from the route, passes it to `usePageAssignment`, and checks the named page with `isRecordPageOf` before it renders. A pending or refused name blocks both the assigned page and the synthesized default.
- `@object-ui/react` exports `isRecordPageOf(page, objectName)`, the single reading of "a record page of object O". `usePageAssignment`'s object-based lookup now filters with it, with unchanged behaviour. The hook's published `pageName` override is NOT narrowed: it still returns any page by that name, and that is pinned. No consumer in the tree relies on it returning a non-record page (measured: the hook's own test only).
- Why a path segment and not a `page` query parameter: it matches the record route's `/edit` sub-route, and the default route's path is untouched. An optional query would let a stray parameter change which document the record route draws. `page` is also a page-scoped list parameter elsewhere.

## Tests

- `RecordDetailView.namedRecordPage-12715.test.tsx` mounts both routes from the real route constant. It pins: the happy path (print root present and idle false while the record read is in flight, then true); the unchanged default route; parity on the default route when its default page is a print page; all three refusal cases (no default page, no other page, no print root, no record read); and skeleton-only while pages load.
- `usePageAssignment.isRecordPageOf-12715.test.tsx` pins the predicate, the lookup reading through it, and the unchanged `pageName` override.
- Each pin was proven red by ablation, with the restored blob equal to HEAD:
  - accept any named page: 2 red
  - ignore the segment: 5 red
  - fall back while pending or refused: 4 red
  - helper ignores the object: 5 red
- Union on the code head: all `RecordDetailView.*` tests (63 files, 397 tests); console route, console app and react hook suites (126 files, 1504 tests). All green.

## Live reading

Showcase backend from published `@objectstack/*` 18.0.0-next.2; console from this branch; headless Chromium with print emulation. One throwaway non-default print record page was added in a scratch copy of the showcase only.

- The named print page has the print root, its letterhead and the record's data, with idle true.
- Unknown, other-object and home-page names each show Page Not Found, with no print root.
- The default route is unchanged.

Screenshots and the reading log: branch `claude/issue-12715-evidence`, folder `evidence/12715/`.

## Acceptance notes

- The default route still draws the synthesized default page briefly while page metadata loads. This is pre-existing and left unchanged on purpose. That page has no print root.
- The refusal reuses the existing `empty.pageNotFound` copy; no locale keys are added.
- objectstack's `print-service.ts` default-page rule is widened in objectstack after its pin carries this change. That is not part of this PR.
